name: Rendering-Guided Regularization for SLAM
definition: A regularization term added to the mapping loss to prevent Gaussian parameters from forgetting previously observed geometry when optimizing for the current frame, allowing the use of a small keyframe buffer instead of queuing all frames.
summary: Rendering-Guided Regularization for SLAM prevents forgetting in 3D Gaussian Splatting by using gradient-based importance weighting to stabilize parameters, unlike methods relying on explicit deformation fields.
